subject: Renewal readiness ledger and exec escalation asks for Stratus AI
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rebecca Chang <rebecca@stratus.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal readiness ledger and exec escalation asks for Stratus AI

Team — looping you in to lock down prep ahead of the 9/21 customer QBR and the renewal discussion. Stratus is a mid‑enterprise account with a potential renewal on 2026‑10‑15 (deal RDW‑3471). Per leadership ask, we need a short ledger that: current health, delta to target ARR, outstanding blockers, and any recommended exec flags.

Quick summary (from initial ops check):
- Current committed ARR: $480k annualized.
- Usage vs. commitment: 78% avg across last 30 days; top latent feature is caching misconfig for inference pools.
- Open severity 2 tickets: 3 (two recent regressions from 8/25–9/07).

Please do the following by EOD Mon 9/13:
1) Update the attached renewal_ledger_v1.xlsx with your sections (account health, support risk, recommended ask/discount band).
2) Flag any item that needs exec attention in the ledger with a one‑line rationale.
3) Call out an owner and proposed escalation time (if we should pull in SVP Sales or CTO).

Target deliverable: one‑page exec summary + ledger row per risk, ready for the exec sync on 9/15. I’ll consolidate and send the exec packet.

Notes: we should also confirm that Stratus has the usage report and open to sharing the upcoming cost optimization suggestions; Rebecca, can your team confirm current infra footprint and whether they will provide the 30‑day usage extract?

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555‑0192

From: Rebecca Chang <rebecca@stratus.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal readiness ledger and exec escalation asks for Stratus AI

Thanks Ben — happy to help. I’ll have our usage team export the last 30 days and share by EOD Monday (account_ops@stratus.ai). Quick clarifications:
- The three open tickets you referenced are under investigation; two are regression results from our rollout on 8/30 and engineering is targeting a patch next week.
- We are looking at an increase in inference batch sizes starting 9/10 which should push utilization up; I’ll include expected uplift numbers in the report.

I’ll attach the usage PDF and a brief note on the upcoming infra changes once I have the export.

Rebecca Chang
Head of Platform Ops | Stratus AI
rebecca@stratus.ai | +1 (650) 555‑0133

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rebecca Chang <rebecca@stratus.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal readiness ledger and exec escalation asks for Stratus AI

Ben / team — I pulled the ledger and added an "exec flag" recommendation on two items:
- Support regressions: mark as HIGH risk — recommends CTO contact if patch slips beyond 9/20. Rationale: impacts latency SLA for their key product flow.
- Usage gap: MEDIUM risk — expected uplift may close gap, but we should plan a short term credit/overage buffer to avoid churn talk in renewal.

I added owners and an ask: Sales to finalize a one‑time amortized credit ask (range included), Solutions to deliver a remediation plan for the regressions, and CS to prepare a usage acceptance note for the QBR.

See my inline comments in renewal_ledger_v1.xlsx (tab: exec_flags). I’ll be on the 9/15 exec sync; if leadership wants a pre‑read, I can prepare the one‑page.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rebecca Chang <rebecca@stratus.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal readiness ledger and exec escalation asks for Stratus AI

Thanks all — consolidated and attached renewal_ledger_v2.xlsx (see exec_summary tab). Actions and final asks below:

- Support regressions: Owner = Solutions (Marissa). Recommend CTO outreach if patch not in staging by 9/20. Exec flag set: HIGH.
- Usage uplift: Owner = CS (Laura). We will present projected uplift numbers Rebecca is sharing; if uplift < 90% by 9/20 propose offer: 3‑month amortized credit up to $45k.
- Legal / Terms: Sales to confirm if the renewal can be standard PO or requires SOW amendment. Ben, please confirm and add to ledger.
- DocuSign: I’ve added a tentative DocuSign envelope for the renewal (https://docusign.com/tx/abc12345) — do not send until we have exec sign‑off.

Related links: HubSpot deal RDW‑3471 and the Google Drive folder in the metadata. I’ve also attached the usage report Rebecca promised (stratus_usage_report_sept.pdf).

Next steps (owners + times):
- Ben: confirm legal path by EOD 9/15.
- Marissa: remediation runbook and ETA by 9/20.
- Laura: confirm uplift numbers and prepare 1‑pager pre‑read by 9/16.
- Rebecca (external): share final usage export by 9/13 (ack).

I’ll prepare the exec packet and a one‑slide decision sheet for 9/15 (SVP Sales + CTO).

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555‑0177
